## What did you try?

Included recording, full local example, or your own app? Describe the workflow without private app or customer data.

## How far did you get?

Which command or step did you finish? Did both videos and the report appear?

## Was the result useful?

What would you use the videos for? What editing or manual help did you still need?

## What blocked you?

OS, Node version, and a sanitized error excerpt if relevant. Do not attach session files, tokens, private recordings, customer data or unreviewed screenshots.
